stories.title: This is the biggest threat to the AI-powered bull market
stories.summary: Blockbuster earnings growth has helped to power the stock market higher in 2026. In 2027, that engine might stall.
stories.zh_title: 這是人工智能驅動的牛市的最大威脅
stories.zh_summary: 重磅利潤增長有助於推動2026年股市走高。在2027年，引擎可能會熄火。

stories.title: For JPMorgan, Amazon, fighting AI bots like Meta Muse may not be a winning long-term strategy
stories.summary: As companies from Amazon to JPMorgan block AI personal agents like Meta's Muse, retail experts warn that technology that removes customer friction usually wins.
stories.zh_title: 對於摩根大通、亞馬遜來說，打擊像Meta Muse這樣的人工智能機器人可能不是一個成功的長期策略
stories.zh_summary: 隨著亞馬遜和摩根大通等公司封鎖像Meta的Muse這樣的人工智能個人代理，零售專家警告說，消除客戶摩擦的技術通常會獲勝。

stories.title: Why AI is boosting Meta's ad business while hurting Google search
stories.summary: The gap between Meta's ad revenue growth and Google's search expansion was the widest it's been since 2021 in the latest quarter.
stories.zh_title: 為什麼人工智慧正在推動Meta的廣告業務，同時損害Google搜尋
stories.zh_summary: 在最近一個季度， Meta的廣告收入增長與Google的搜索擴張之間的差距是自2021年以來最大的。

stories.title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’
stories.summary: Data centers are deeply unpopular. But what if we called them something else?
stories.zh_title: OpenAI可能會將其數據中心重新命名為「AI計算園區」
stories.zh_summary: 數據中心非常不受歡迎。但如果我們稱他們為其他人呢？

stories.title: Top Wall Street analysts are bullish on these 3 stocks for the long haul
stories.summary: Investors looking beyond short-term noise and focusing on long-term returns can track top analysts to pick the right stocks, backed by strong research.
stories.zh_title: 華爾街頂級分析師長期看好這3隻股票
stories.zh_summary: 超越短期噪音並關注長期回報的投資者可以追蹤頂級分析師，在強勁的研究支持下選擇合適的股票。

stories.title: The midterm election could reshape the muni bond market. Here’s what investors need to know
stories.summary: The 2026 election could affect municipal bonds through state tax measures, new bond supply and the makeup of Congress.
stories.zh_title: 中期選舉可能會重塑市政債券市場。以下是投資者需要知道的事項
stories.zh_summary: 2026年的選舉可能會通過州稅措施、新的債券供應和國會的組成來影響市政債券。

stories.title: Apple’s new earnings era begins at a critical time for Big Tech
stories.summary: A rare Monday earnings report for Apple will give investors a glimpse into how new CEO John Ternus is managing inflated memory prices and a tougher backdrop for consumer spending.
stories.zh_title: 蘋果的新盈利時代開始於大型科技公司的關鍵時刻
stories.zh_summary: 蘋果週一罕見的盈利報告將讓投資者一窺新任首席執行官約翰·特納斯(John Ternus)如何管理過高的記憶體價格，以及消費者支出的艱難背景。

stories.title: AI can make tech CEOs’ lives easier. What about everyone else?
stories.summary: On Equity, we discuss why tech CEO statements can seem so tone deaf.
stories.zh_title: 人工智能可以使科技CEO的生活更輕鬆。其他人呢？
stories.zh_summary: 關於Equity ，我們討論了為什麼科技執行長的聲明看起來如此充耳不聞。

stories.title: Who really wins under Trump’s economy? Coastal liberal elites who hate him.
stories.summary: In other words, not the people Republicans likely intended.
stories.zh_title: 在特朗普的經濟下，誰真正贏得勝利？憎恨他的沿海自由派精英
stories.zh_summary: 換句話說，這可能不是共和黨人想要的。

stories.title: Chatbots Are Leading Hikers Astray, With Dangerous Consequences
stories.summary: Outsourcing planning to AI can lead people to surrender their own critical thinking, which can have potentially deadly results in places like the backcountry.
stories.zh_title: 聊天機器人是領先的徒步旅行者，具有危險的後果
stories.zh_summary: 將規劃外包給人工智慧可能會導致人們放棄自己的批判性思維，這可能會在像偏遠地區這樣的地方產生致命的結果。
